approaches_tried.approach: Case 69 (no sapience binary): use two separately-built build_path_without_sapience() scratch dirs for the before/after hook invocations
approaches_tried.reason: each call to build_path_without_sapience() creates a NEW scratch dir, so python3's resolved absolute path (a symlink inside that scratch dir) differed between the two runs; setup-sapience-mcp.sh's resolve_interpreter() always re-resolves via 'command -v python3' (it only inherits from the TOP-LEVEL global .mcpServers.sapience.command, never from the project-scoped entry this writer actually writes), so the differing python3 path made the writer judge the existing project entry 'diverged' and rewrite it, spuriously firing the MCP-registration notice on the second run. Fixed by using ONE shared scratch directory for both runs and only adding/removing the 'sapience' file from it between them (install_sapience_stub_into helper), so python3's resolved path is byte-identical across both invocations and only the presence of 'sapience' differs.
